senses.gloss: (b. h.) to break forth (v. גִּיחַ); to gore, butt, fight.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 5:1">B. Kam. V, 1</cite> <he>שור שנ׳ וכ׳</he> if an ox gored a cow, and her embryo is found (dead) by her side.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אם עד שלא נְגָחָהּ וכ׳</he> whether she gave birth before he gored her. Tosef. ib. IV, 6 <he>עד שיתכוין לִיגַּח</he> unless he pushes intentionally. Ib. 10 <he>יש בנוֹגֵחַ וכ׳</he> there are laws concerning the butter (that killed a person) which do not apply &c.; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite>, end <he>נוגח דם</he> some ed., read: <he>גּוֹנֵחַ</he>.]
<cite ref="Chullin 51a:10">Ḥull. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>זכרים המְנַגְּחִין וכ׳</he> rams that butt one another.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41">Ex. R. s. 41</cite>, end <he>אתמול מְנַגֵּחַ בהם וכ׳</he> yesterday he (Moses) pushed them (the angels of destruction) away, and now he is afraid of them. Tanḥ. Balak 3; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>, beg. <he>מה שור מנ׳ … מְנַגְּחִים וכ׳</he> as the ox fights with his horns, so do the Israelites fight (their enemies) with their prayers.

<cite ref="Berakhot 56b:16">Ber. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>נְגָחוֹ … שמְנַגְּחִין בתורה</he> if (in his dream) an ox attacked him, he will have children who fight in (discussing) the Law; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְנוּגָּח</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 3:6">Tosef. B. Kam. III, 6</cite> <he>אפי׳ זה מנ׳</he> even if the one is found gored.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 4:4">B. Kam. IV, 4</cite> <he>כי יִגַּח שלא שיַגִּיחוּהוּ</he> ‘if he butt’ (<cite ref="Exodus 21:28">Ex. XXI, 28</cite>), but not when they stir him up (in the arena).

senses.gloss: to fight with one another. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 4 שור וארי מִתְנַגְּחִין וכ׳ ox and lion fighting with each other; a. e.
